#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
## Purpose: Drain acquisition and release of actual file custody across asynchronous operations.
##

"""Cancellation cannot discard a successfully acquired file lease or abandon its release."""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager, asynccontextmanager
from threading import Event

from scripts.contexts.runtime_storage.infrastructure.persistence.async_io import run_file_io


@asynccontextmanager
async def held_file_context[T](context: AbstractContextManager[T]) -> AsyncIterator[T]:
    """Keep acquisition observable on cancellation; file lock exits only release custody."""
    entered = Event()

    def acquire() -> T:
        value = context.__enter__()
        entered.set()
        return value

    async def release() -> None:
        await run_file_io(context.__exit__, None, None, None)

    try:
        value = await run_file_io(acquire)
    except BaseException:
        if entered.is_set():
            await release()
        raise
    try:
        yield value
    finally:
        await release()
